description: The line plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs for four different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper small model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid orange line with circular markers) starts at WER ≈ 35.6 at epoch 0, peaks at ≈ 38.5 at epoch 1, then declines steadily to ≈ 30.8 at epoch 6. “small AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed orange line with square markers) begins at WER ≈ 30.1, rises to ≈ 33.3 at epoch 1, dips to ≈ 28.0 at epoch 3, and ends at ≈ 25.6 at epoch 6. “small int8” (dashed orange line with circular markers) starts at ≈ 35.6, climbs sharply to a peak of ≈ 41.8 at epoch 2, then declines to ≈ 31.5 at epoch 6. The fourth line, labeled “small int8” in the legend but visually matching the “small AdaLoRA_int8” line (solid orange with square markers), begins at ≈ 30.1, drops to ≈ 29.8 at epoch 1, then falls to ≈ 25.3 at epoch 6. The plot includes a legend in the upper right, though one entry appears mislabeled or duplicated.
